description: Fixed rubrics for /better-skill when reviewing pipeline, command, or skill drafts.

subagents.pattern: Wide read-only recon (explore subagent or MCP) before edits; parent owns writes and *_verify.py.

validation_done.pattern: Done criteria name exit code, artefact path, or verifier mode — not vague success.

verification_schema.pattern: Playbook steps align with contract JSON and verifier flags.

iterative_subsets.pattern: Phases or bundles are bounded; temp/ deleted; no unbounded Jira crawl.
